# Ceramiche Artistiche Bressan C2

> Family-run Italian artisan ceramics business in Pianezze, Vicenza, creating hand-painted artistic ceramics for shops, boutiques and points of sale.

This website is a visual catalogue, not an ecommerce store, and does not offer online checkout. Purchases can be made directly from the Pianezze premises, Monday to Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 6:30 p.m.; the business is closed on Saturdays and Sundays.

## Main pages

* [Company](/en/company): Business, location and company details.
* [History](/en/history): The story of Bruno Bressan, the family business and its historical awards.
* [Collections](/en/creations): Overview of six ceramic product families, grouped by use and decorative motif, with links to their individual lines in the catalogue.
* [Catalog](/en/catalog): Individual ceramic lines organized into the six families. Each line has a card and a photo gallery showing its pieces and decorations.
* [For retailers](/en/retailers): Information for shops and points of sale.
* [Workmanship](/en/workmanship): Hand decoration and artisan production.
* [Contact](/en/contact): Business enquiries and workshop location.
